ibm_heron_stage3.statistical_methodology_note: In Stage 3A (dbnmjd8qtr0c73adatk0), M3 (8 PUBs), M4 (8 PUBs in G00..G07), M5 (8 PUBs in G00..G07), and M0b (16 isolated PUBs) have zero shared physical PUBs across the K = 8 disjoint groups G00..G07 (df = 7). However, M1 packed 4 Short workloads per physical PUB (4 PUBs M1_SS_0..3) and M2 packed 4 Long workloads per physical PUB (4 PUBs M2_LL_0..3), so pairs of groups (G00,G01), (G02,G03), (G04,G05), and (G06,G07) share the same physical M1 and M2 execution shots. Therefore, all comparisons involving M1 or M6 (which combines M1 + M2) are clustered at the K = 4 independent physical-PUB super-clusters C0..C3 (df = 3).
